name: holes
question: Control: plain through-holes, already known to work.
prompt: A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 6mm thick, centered on the origin. It has 4 through holes of 5mm diameter, with centers at (-20, -20), (20, -20), (20, 20) and (-20, 20). The holes go through the full 6mm thickness.
kcl:
/*
Generated by Text-to-CAD:
A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 6mm thick, centered on the origin. It has 4 through holes of 5mm diameter, with centers at (-20, -20), (20, -20), (20, 20) and (-20, 20). The holes go through the full 6mm thickness.
*/
@settings(kclVersion = 2.0, defaultLengthUnit = mm)

plateWidth = 60mm
plateDepth = 60mm
plateThickness = 6mm
holeDiameter = 5mm
holeOffset = 20mm
holePitch = holeOffset * 2
cutMargin = 1mm

plateSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var -30mm])
  rightEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var 30mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var 30mm])
  leftEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var -30mm])

  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightEdge.start])
  coincident([rightEdge.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftEdge.start])
  coincident([leftEdge.end, bottomEdge.start])
  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  vertical(rightEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftEdge)
  distance([bottomEdge.start, bottomEdge.end]) == plateWidth
  distance([rightEdge.start, rightEdge.end]) == plateDepth
  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateWidth / 2
  verticalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateDepth / 2
}

plateRegion = region(
  segments = [
    plateSketch.bottomEdge,
    plateSketch.rightEdge
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
plateBlank = extrude(plateRegion, length = plateThickness, symmetric = true)
hiddenPlateSketch = hide(plateSketch)

holeSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  holeCircle = circle(start = [var -17.5mm, var -20mm], center = [var -20mm, var -20mm])

  horizontal([holeCircle.center, holeCircle.start])
  horizontalDistance([holeCircle.center, ORIGIN]) == holeOffset
  verticalDistance([holeCircle.center, ORIGIN]) == holeOffset
  diameter(holeCircle) == holeDiameter
}

holeRegion = region(segments = [holeSketch.holeCircle])
holeSeedCutter = extrude(
  holeRegion,
  length = plateThickness + cutMargin * 2,
  symmetric = true,
  method = NEW,
)
holeCutters = patternLinear3d(
  patternLinear3d(
    holeSeedCutter,
    instances = 2,
    distance = holePitch,
    axis = X,
  ),
  instances = 2,
  distance = holePitch,
  axis = Y,
)
finishedPlate = subtract(plateBlank, tools = holeCutters)
hiddenHoleSketch = hide(holeSketch)

name: slot
question: THE BLOCKER for item 5: can it build an obround adjustment slot?
prompt: A flat rectangular plate 80mm wide, 60mm deep and 6mm thick, centered on the origin. It has 2 slots cut through the full thickness. Each slot is 20mm long and 6mm wide with semicircular ends, with its long axis along the X direction. The first slot is centered at (-25, 0) and the second at (25, 0).
kcl:
/*
Generated by Text-to-CAD:
A flat rectangular plate 80mm wide, 60mm deep and 6mm thick, centered on the origin. It has 2 slots cut through the full thickness. Each slot is 20mm long and 6mm wide with semicircular ends, with its long axis along the X direction. The first slot is centered at (-25, 0) and the second at (25, 0).
*/
@settings(defaultLengthUnit = mm, kclVersion = 2.0)

plateWidth = 80mm
plateDepth = 60mm
plateThickness = 6mm
slotLength = 20mm
slotWidth = 6mm
slotRadius = slotWidth / 2
slotCenterSpacing = slotLength - slotWidth
firstSlotCenterX = -25mm
secondSlotCenterX = 25mm
cutOverlap = 1mm

plateSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var -40mm, var -30mm], end = [var 40mm, var -30mm])
  rightEdge = line(start = [var 40mm, var -30mm], end = [var 40mm, var 30mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 40mm, var 30mm], end = [var -40mm, var 30mm])
  leftEdge = line(start = [var -40mm, var 30mm], end = [var -40mm, var -30mm])

  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightEdge.start])
  coincident([rightEdge.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftEdge.start])
  coincident([leftEdge.end, bottomEdge.start])
  coincident([bottomEdge.start, [-40mm, -30mm]])

  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  vertical(rightEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftEdge)
  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, bottomEdge.end]) == plateWidth
  verticalDistance([rightEdge.start, rightEdge.end]) == plateDepth
}

plateRegion = region(
  segments = [
    plateSketch.bottomEdge,
    plateSketch.rightEdge
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
plateBlank = extrude(
  plateRegion,
  length = plateThickness,
  symmetric = true,
  method = NEW,
)
hide(plateSketch)

firstSlotSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  leftArc = arc(start = [var -32mm, var 3mm], end = [var -32mm, var -3mm], center = [var -32mm, var 0mm])
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var -32mm, var -3mm], end = [var -18mm, var -3mm])
  rightArc = arc(start = [var -18mm, var -3mm], end = [var -18mm, var 3mm], center = [var -18mm, var 0mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var -18mm, var 3mm], end = [var -32mm, var 3mm])

  leftTopGuide = line(start = [var -32mm, var 0mm], end = [var -32mm, var 3mm], construction = true)
  leftBottomGuide = line(start = [var -32mm, var 0mm], end = [var -32mm, var -3mm], construction = true)
  rightBottomGuide = line(start = [var -18mm, var 0mm], end = [var -18mm, var -3mm], construction = true)
  rightTopGuide = line(start = [var -18mm, var 0mm], end = [var -18mm, var 3mm], construction = true)

  coincident([leftArc.end, bottomEdge.start])
  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightArc.start])
  coincident([rightArc.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftArc.start])

  coincident([leftTopGuide.start, leftArc.center])
  coincident([leftTopGuide.end, leftArc.start])
  coincident([leftBottomGuide.start, leftArc.center])
  coincident([leftBottomGuide.end, leftArc.end])
  coincident([
    rightBottomGuide.start,
    rightArc.center
  ])
  coincident([rightBottomGuide.end, rightArc.start])
  coincident([rightTopGuide.start, rightArc.center])
  coincident([rightTopGuide.end, rightArc.end])

  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftTopGuide)
  vertical(leftBottomGuide)
  vertical(rightBottomGuide)
  vertical(rightTopGuide)
  horizontal([leftArc.center, rightArc.center])

  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, leftArc.center]) == firstSlotCenterX - (slotCenterSpacing / 2)
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, leftArc.center]) == 0mm
  horizontalDistance([leftArc.center, rightArc.center]) == slotCenterSpacing
  radius(leftArc) == slotRadius
  radius(rightArc) == slotRadius
}

firstSlotRegion = region(
  segments = [
    firstSlotSketch.leftArc,
    firstSlotSketch.bottomEdge
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
firstSlotCutter = extrude(
  firstSlotRegion,
  length = plateThickness + 2 * cutOverlap,
  symmetric = true,
  method = NEW,
)
hide(firstSlotSketch)

secondSlotSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  leftArc = arc(start = [var 18mm, var 3mm], end = [var 18mm, var -3mm], center = [var 18mm, var 0mm])
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var 18mm, var -3mm], end = [var 32mm, var -3mm])
  rightArc = arc(start = [var 32mm, var -3mm], end = [var 32mm, var 3mm], center = [var 32mm, var 0mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 32mm, var 3mm], end = [var 18mm, var 3mm])

  leftTopGuide = line(start = [var 18mm, var 0mm], end = [var 18mm, var 3mm], construction = true)
  leftBottomGuide = line(start = [var 18mm, var 0mm], end = [var 18mm, var -3mm], construction = true)
  rightBottomGuide = line(start = [var 32mm, var 0mm], end = [var 32mm, var -3mm], construction = true)
  rightTopGuide = line(start = [var 32mm, var 0mm], end = [var 32mm, var 3mm], construction = true)

  coincident([leftArc.end, bottomEdge.start])
  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightArc.start])
  coincident([rightArc.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftArc.start])

  coincident([leftTopGuide.start, leftArc.center])
  coincident([leftTopGuide.end, leftArc.start])
  coincident([leftBottomGuide.start, leftArc.center])
  coincident([leftBottomGuide.end, leftArc.end])
  coincident([
    rightBottomGuide.start,
    rightArc.center
  ])
  coincident([rightBottomGuide.end, rightArc.start])
  coincident([rightTopGuide.start, rightArc.center])
  coincident([rightTopGuide.end, rightArc.end])

  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftTopGuide)
  vertical(leftBottomGuide)
  vertical(rightBottomGuide)
  vertical(rightTopGuide)
  horizontal([leftArc.center, rightArc.center])

  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, leftArc.center]) == secondSlotCenterX - (slotCenterSpacing / 2)
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, leftArc.center]) == 0mm
  horizontalDistance([leftArc.center, rightArc.center]) == slotCenterSpacing
  radius(leftArc) == slotRadius
  radius(rightArc) == slotRadius
}

secondSlotRegion = region(
  segments = [
    secondSlotSketch.leftArc,
    secondSlotSketch.bottomEdge
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
secondSlotCutter = extrude(
  secondSlotRegion,
  length = plateThickness + 2 * cutOverlap,
  symmetric = true,
  method = NEW,
)
hide(secondSlotSketch)

plateWithSlots = subtract(plateBlank, tools = [firstSlotCutter, secondSlotCutter])

finishedPlate = appearance(
  plateWithSlots,
  color = "#b8bec6",
  metalness = 35,
  roughness = 45,
)

name: counterbore
question: Can it build a counterbored hole (two concentric diameters)?
prompt: A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 10mm thick, centered on the origin. It has one counterbored hole at the center: a 5mm diameter hole through the full 10mm thickness, opening into a 10mm diameter counterbore 4mm deep from the top face.
kcl:
/*

A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 10mm thick, centered on the origin. It has one counterbored hole at the center: a 5mm diameter hole through the full 10mm thickness, opening into a 10mm diameter counterbore 4mm deep from the top face.
*/
@settings(defaultLengthUnit = mm, kclVersion = 2.0)

plateWidth = 60mm
plateDepth = 60mm
plateThickness = 10mm
throughHoleDiameter = 5mm
counterboreDiameter = 10mm
counterboreDepth = 4mm

plateSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var -30mm])
  rightEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var 30mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var 30mm])
  leftEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var -30mm])

  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightEdge.start])
  coincident([rightEdge.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftEdge.start])
  coincident([leftEdge.end, bottomEdge.start])

  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  vertical(rightEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftEdge)

  distance([bottomEdge.start, bottomEdge.end]) == plateWidth
  distance([rightEdge.start, rightEdge.end]) == plateDepth
  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateWidth / 2
  verticalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateDepth / 2
}

plateRegion = region(
  segments = [
    plateSketch.bottomEdge,
    plateSketch.rightEdge
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
plateBlank = extrude(plateRegion, length = plateThickness, symmetric = true)
hide(plateSketch)

throughHoleSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  throughHoleCircle = circle(start = [var 2.5mm, var 0mm], center = [var 0mm, var 0mm])
  coincident([throughHoleCircle.center, ORIGIN])
  horizontal([
    throughHoleCircle.center,
    throughHoleCircle.start
  ])
  diameter(throughHoleCircle) == throughHoleDiameter
}

throughHoleRegion = region(segments = [throughHoleSketch.throughHoleCircle])
throughHoleCutter = extrude(throughHoleRegion, length = plateThickness, symmetric = true)
plateWithThroughHole = subtract(plateBlank, tools = [throughHoleCutter])
hide(throughHoleSketch)

counterboreSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  counterboreCircle = circle(start = [var 5mm, var 0mm], center = [var 0mm, var 0mm])
  coincident([counterboreCircle.center, ORIGIN])
  horizontal([
    counterboreCircle.center,
    counterboreCircle.start
  ])
  diameter(counterboreCircle) == counterboreDiameter
}

counterboreRegion = region(segments = [counterboreSketch.counterboreCircle])
counterboreCutter = extrude(counterboreRegion, length = counterboreDepth)
  |> translate(z = plateThickness / 2 - counterboreDepth, global = true)
finishedPlate = subtract(plateWithThroughHole, tools = [counterboreCutter])
hide(counterboreSketch)

name: pocket
question: Can it build a blind rectangular pocket?
prompt: A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 10mm thick, centered on the origin. A rectangular pocket 30mm by 30mm and 4mm deep is cut into the top face, centered on the origin. The pocket is blind -- it does not go through the plate.
kcl:
/*
Generated by Text-to-CAD:
A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 10mm thick, centered on the origin. A rectangular pocket 30mm by 30mm and 4mm deep is cut into the top face, centered on the origin. The pocket is blind -- it does not go through the plate.
*/
@settings(kclVersion = 2.0, defaultLengthUnit = mm)

plateWidth = 60mm
plateDepth = 60mm
plateThickness = 10mm
pocketWidth = 30mm
pocketDepth = 30mm
pocketCutDepth = 4mm
cutOverlap = 0.1mm

plateSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var -30mm])
  rightEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var 30mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var 30mm])
  leftEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var -30mm])

  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightEdge.start])
  coincident([rightEdge.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftEdge.start])
  coincident([leftEdge.end, bottomEdge.start])
  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  vertical(rightEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftEdge)
  distance([bottomEdge.start, bottomEdge.end]) == plateWidth
  distance([rightEdge.start, rightEdge.end]) == plateDepth
  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateWidth / 2
  verticalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateDepth / 2
}

plateRegion = region(
  segments = [
    plateSketch.bottomEdge,
    plateSketch.rightEdge
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
plateBlank = extrude(plateRegion, length = plateThickness, symmetric = true)

pocketTopZ = plateThickness / 2 + cutOverlap
pocketSketch = sketch(on = offsetPlane(XY, offset = pocketTopZ)) {
  pocketBottom = line(start = [var -15mm, var -15mm], end = [var 15mm, var -15mm])
  pocketRight = line(start = [var 15mm, var -15mm], end = [var 15mm, var 15mm])
  pocketTop = line(start = [var 15mm, var 15mm], end = [var -15mm, var 15mm])
  pocketLeft = line(start = [var -15mm, var 15mm], end = [var -15mm, var -15mm])

  coincident([pocketBottom.end, pocketRight.start])
  coincident([pocketRight.end, pocketTop.start])
  coincident([pocketTop.end, pocketLeft.start])
  coincident([pocketLeft.end, pocketBottom.start])
  horizontal(pocketBottom)
  vertical(pocketRight)
  horizontal(pocketTop)
  vertical(pocketLeft)
  distance([pocketBottom.start, pocketBottom.end]) == pocketWidth
  distance([pocketRight.start, pocketRight.end]) == pocketDepth
  horizontalDistance([pocketBottom.start, ORIGIN]) == pocketWidth / 2
  verticalDistance([pocketBottom.start, ORIGIN]) == pocketDepth / 2
}

pocketRegion = region(
  segments = [
    pocketSketch.pocketBottom,
    pocketSketch.pocketRight
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
pocketCutter = extrude(pocketRegion, length = -(pocketCutDepth + cutOverlap), method = NEW)
finishedPlate = subtract([plateBlank], tools = [pocketCutter])

hiddenPlateSketch = hide(plateSketch)
hiddenPocketSketch = hide(pocketSketch)

findings.label: volume (proves the pocket is cut and blind)

name: boss
question: Can it build a raised boss (added material, not a cut)?

/*

@settings(defaultLengthUnit = mm, kclVersion = 2.0)

plateWidth = 60mm
plateDepth = 60mm
plateThickness = 6mm
bossDiameter = 20mm
bossHeight = 5mm
bossJoinOverlap = 0.1mm

plateSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var -30mm])
  rightEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var 30mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var 30mm])
  leftEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var -30mm])

  coincident([bottomEdge.end, rightEdge.start])
  coincident([rightEdge.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, leftEdge.start])
  coincident([leftEdge.end, bottomEdge.start])
  horizontal(bottomEdge)
  vertical(rightEdge)
  horizontal(topEdge)
  vertical(leftEdge)
  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, bottomEdge.end]) == plateWidth
  verticalDistance([bottomEdge.start, leftEdge.start]) == plateDepth
  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateWidth / 2
  verticalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == plateDepth / 2
}

plateRegion = region(
  segments = [
    plateSketch.bottomEdge,
    plateSketch.rightEdge
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
plateBlank = extrude(plateRegion, length = plateThickness, symmetric = true)

bossSketch = sketch(on = XY) {
  bossCircle = circle(start = [var 10mm, var 0mm], center = [var 0mm, var 0mm])
  coincident([bossCircle.center, ORIGIN])
  horizontal([bossCircle.center, bossCircle.start])

bossRegion = region(segments = [bossSketch.bossCircle])
bossBody = extrude(bossRegion, length = bossHeight + bossJoinOverlap, symmetric = true)

finishedPart = union([plateBlank, bossBody])
  |> appearance(color = "#B8C4CC", metalness = 35, roughness = 35)

hide(plateSketch)
hide(bossSketch)

name: chamfer
question: Can it apply a chamfer to named edges?
prompt: A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 6mm thick, centered on the origin. Each of the 4 vertical corner edges has a 15mm by 15mm chamfer running the full 6mm height.
kcl:
/*
Generated by Text-to-CAD:
A flat rectangular plate 60mm wide, 60mm deep and 6mm thick, centered on the origin. Each of the 4 vertical corner edges has a 15mm by 15mm chamfer running the full 6mm height.
*/
@settings(defaultLengthUnit = mm, kclVersion = 2.0)

plateWidth = 60mm
plateDepth = 60mm
plateThickness = 6mm
cornerChamfer = 15mm
halfWidth = plateWidth / 2
halfDepth = plateDepth / 2
cornerInsetX = halfWidth - cornerChamfer
cornerInsetY = halfDepth - cornerChamfer

plateProfile = sketch(on = XY) {
  bottomEdge = line(start = [var -15mm, var -30mm], end = [var 15mm, var -30mm])
  lowerRightChamfer = line(start = [var 15mm, var -30mm], end = [var 30mm, var -15mm])
  rightEdge = line(start = [var 30mm, var -15mm], end = [var 30mm, var 15mm])
  upperRightChamfer = line(start = [var 30mm, var 15mm], end = [var 15mm, var 30mm])
  topEdge = line(start = [var 15mm, var 30mm], end = [var -15mm, var 30mm])
  upperLeftChamfer = line(start = [var -15mm, var 30mm], end = [var -30mm, var 15mm])
  leftEdge = line(start = [var -30mm, var 15mm], end = [var -30mm, var -15mm])
  lowerLeftChamfer = line(start = [var -30mm, var -15mm], end = [var -15mm, var -30mm])

  coincident([
    bottomEdge.end,
    lowerRightChamfer.start
  ])
  coincident([lowerRightChamfer.end, rightEdge.start])
  coincident([rightEdge.end, upperRightChamfer.start])
  coincident([upperRightChamfer.end, topEdge.start])
  coincident([topEdge.end, upperLeftChamfer.start])
  coincident([upperLeftChamfer.end, leftEdge.start])
  coincident([leftEdge.end, lowerLeftChamfer.start])
  coincident([lowerLeftChamfer.end, bottomEdge.start])

  horizontalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == cornerInsetX
  verticalDistance([bottomEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == halfDepth
  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, lowerRightChamfer.start]) == cornerInsetX
  verticalDistance([lowerRightChamfer.start, ORIGIN]) == halfDepth
  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, rightEdge.start]) == halfWidth
  verticalDistance([rightEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == cornerInsetY
  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, upperRightChamfer.start]) == halfWidth
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, upperRightChamfer.start]) == cornerInsetY
  horizontalDistance([ORIGIN, topEdge.start]) == cornerInsetX
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, topEdge.start]) == halfDepth
  horizontalDistance([upperLeftChamfer.start, ORIGIN]) == cornerInsetX
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, upperLeftChamfer.start]) == halfDepth
  horizontalDistance([leftEdge.start, ORIGIN]) == halfWidth
  verticalDistance([ORIGIN, leftEdge.start]) == cornerInsetY
  horizontalDistance([lowerLeftChamfer.start, ORIGIN]) == halfWidth
  verticalDistance([lowerLeftChamfer.start, ORIGIN]) == cornerInsetY
}

plateRegion = region(
  segments = [
    plateProfile.bottomEdge,
    plateProfile.lowerRightChamfer
  ],
  intersectionIndex = -1,
  direction = CCW,
)
plate = extrude(plateRegion, length = plateThickness, symmetric = true)
hide(plateProfile)
